thread:
incident-bot: P1 alert: sustained p99 >= 2.5s in us-east-1, streaming tail stalls detected on /v1/chat/stream and /v1/generate. Alerts: latency_slo_breach, streaming_tail_stalls. Paging: @adele @mike.
adele: I'm taking this. KV eviction spikes visible on shard kv-12; prefill queue piling up. p95 climbed to ~1.1s, p99 >3s for streaming.
mike: dashboards linked -> https://console/redwood/d/us-east-1/kv-cache (eviction_rate, prefill_vs_decode).
adele: logs show a shift at 12:03 UTC: decode worker latency doubled, eviction_count multiplied. Looks like shard-local fragmentation + prefill starvation.
len: joining. Customer impact? any aborted streams?
sam: some client reconnects and token gaps. 3 customers reported stalls; 500s were rare. Streaming p95 target 500ms is breached.
ops-bot: runbook kv-cache-pressure: 1) throttle streaming concurrency, 2) increase prefill workers, 3) relax eviction aggressiveness. See https://runbooks/kv-pressure
adele: quick metric snapshot before mitigation: kv_eviction_rate 413 -> 1800/min; prefill_queue_depth 8 -> 92; decode_latency_p95 120ms -> 750ms; streaming_stalls 0.2% -> 3.8%.
mike: proposed live mitigations: a) lower gateway max_streaming_concurrency 500->300 for us-east-1, b) bump prefill_worker_count +30% via feature-flag, c) increase eviction threshold from 0.7->0.82 to be less aggressive.
adele: applied feature flag: `infractl feature-flag set us-east-1 prefill_workers +30% --reason \"live mitigation\"`
ops-bot: feature flag accepted and propagating to 24 nodes.
deploy-bot: rolling config update started: gateway-config-update (streaming concurrency) -> us-east-1.
mike: enabling temporary TTL extension for streaming keys to avoid immediate evictions: `cachectl set ttl_extend true --route streaming`
len: watch mem usage — TTL extension could worsen memory. What's rollback plan?
adele: monitor mem; if host mem >85% revert TTL and reduce prefill. Command to revert: `infractl feature-flag unset us-east-1 prefill_workers`
sam: after changes at 12:18 UTC: prefill_queue_depth 92 -> 27; eviction_rate 1800 -> 920/min; decode_p95 -> ~320ms; streaming_stalls 3.8% -> 1.0%.
mike: still seeing p99 spikes for long-running sessions (>5k tokens). Suspect hotkeys and shard-local fragmentation.
adele: routing idea: move long sessions to a dedicated large-cache pool. `routingctl set route long-session -> dedicated-pool-large --duration 1h`
ops-bot: routing rule applied. This affects ~0.4% of requests but a big portion of tail token volume.
adele: customer impact summary: 3 customers filed complaints, ~2.3% of streaming sessions in us-east-1 experienced degraded latency during the peak window. No data loss or leakage. Most client errors were retries/reconnects.
len: preparing 30m handoff to night oncall @oncall-next at 13:00 UTC. Include state, mitigations, runbook links.
adele: handoff notes (copy): Incident: KV cache pressure + fragmentation -> streaming tail stalls and p99 SLO breaches in us-east-1. Actions: lowered gateway streaming concurrency, +30% prefill workers, TTL extension for streaming keys, routed long sessions to dedicated pool. Current metrics: p95 ~420ms, p99 ~980ms (improved but still above target), streaming_stalls ~0.9%. Risks: memory pressure from TTL extension; dedicated-pool capacity constraints. Next steps: monitor per-host mem/evict, run slab compaction in low-traffic window, consider controlled cache defrag if fragmentation persists.
mike: logs for handoff (grep sample):
```
grep -E \"evict|prefill|decode\" /var/log/kv/kv-12.log | tail -n 200
# sample lines:
2026-03-14T12:12:01Z evict key=abc shard=12 reason=frag size=8k
2026-03-14T12:12:02Z prefill queued key=xyz shard=12
2026-03-14T12:16:34Z decode latency=840ms key=longsession1
```
oncall-next: ack. I'll take over at 13:00 UTC. Will keep throttles and routing in place, monitor mem/evict trends, and escalate if deterioration. Please leave outstanding commands in notes.
adele: leaving revert hints: `infractl feature-flag unset us-east-1 prefill_workers` and `cachectl set ttl_extend false --route streaming`
ops-bot: incident severity downgraded: mitigated -> monitoring (P1->P2) by @adele.
incident-bot: timeline: created 1785006789, mitigations applied 1785007080, handoff 1785007209.
mike: follow-up: request scheduled slab compaction job tomorrow 02:00 UTC, 30m maintenance window, to shrink slabs and reduce fragmentation.
len: will coordinate with infra and ops for a controlled compaction and warm cache prefill.
adele: thanks all, leaving channel. :thumbsup:
